subject: Warm failover verification plan — ClearNorth BCP follow-up
messages:
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa@redwood.com>
To: security@clearnorth.com
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 20 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Warm failover verification plan — ClearNorth BCP follow-up

Hi Lara / ClearNorth security team,

Following up on your SOC 2 evidence request — attaching a short warm-failover playbook excerpt we can share immediately and a proposed verification checklist. High level: Redwood runs warm-standby pools with KV cache warm-start and a scripted warm-failover sequence we can exercise in a controlled window.

What I'm asking for from you:
- Confirm a 90-minute window on either May 27 or May 28 for a non-prod failover tabletop + live verification (no customer traffic).
- Tell us any evidence format you prefer (CSV exports for traces / PDF assertions).

What we'll provide ahead of the call:
- WarmFailover_Playbook_v1.pdf (attached) — excerpted runbook and pre/post-checklist
- RTO traces from our last rehearsal and KV warm-start logs (we'll upload CSV/TXT)
- A short replay of the warm-failover run in a recording, and a Drive link with artifacts

If those dates don't work, propose alternatives and we'll coordinate with engineering.

Thanks — happy to jump on a quick sync if helpful.

Best,
Tessa Morgan
Account Manager, Redwood Inference
T: +1 415-555-0123
[Attachment: WarmFailover_Playbook_v1.pdf (PDF, 1.2MB)]
From: Lara Holt <lara.holt@clearnorth.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 21 May 2027 10:03:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Warm failover verification plan — ClearNorth BCP follow-up

Tessa — thanks, and appreciate the quick turnaround. A few clarifying asks before we lock a window: 

1) For SOC 2 evidence mapping we need an RTO timeline tied to specific service components (API gateway, KV cache, model inference service). Can you provide a short mapping table (component -> measured failover time) for the last rehearsal? CSV is fine.

2) We need a signed attestation from your ops lead that the rehearsal was run against the dedicated non-prod pool and that production traffic was not affected. A one-paragraph signed statement is OK.

3) Preference for the verification window: May 28, 08:00–09:30 PT. Please confirm availability of engineers to answer live technical questions (KV warm-start, cache priming, and any roll-back steps).

We can share a brief SOC 2 template mapping doc before the call if helpful.

> Following up on your SOC 2 evidence request — attaching a short warm-failover playbook excerpt we can share immediately and a proposed verification checklist.

Thanks,
Lara

Hi Lara — Ben here (Redwood Ops). Quick answers and what we'll attach: 

- Component-level RTOs: see attached rto-trace-20270515.csv. It includes three rows per component (API gateway, inference-service, kv-cache) with timestamps for detection, failover start, and warm-restore complete. Measured median RTO for the components you listed: API gateway 18s, inference-service 95s, kv-cache 42s (these are from a controlled rehearsal run on 2027-05-15).

- Attestation: Marcus Lin (cc'd) will send a short signed paragraph confirming the rehearsal scope and that production traffic was not affected.

- Engineers on call: Jordan will be on the sync to walk through the KV priming steps; I will handle the trace walk-through and live logs. We'll also bring an engineer for the model service if you want deeper detail.

Attachments included: rto-trace-20270515.csv, kv-warmstart-logs-20270515.txt, tabletop-invite.ics
Drive link to artifacts: https://drive.redwood.com/clearnorth/BCP/WarmFailover_Playbook_v1.pdf

Proposed agenda for May 28, 08:00–09:30 PT:
- 08:00–08:10 Intro & scope
- 08:10–08:30 Trace walkthrough (Ben)
- 08:30–08:50 KV warm-start demo + log tailing (Jordan)
- 08:50–09:10 Q&A and attestation review
- 09:10–09:30 Next steps and evidence hand-off (Tessa)

Let us know if you want the rehearsal recording as a separate MP4; we can provide that as well.

Best,
Ben Carter
Principal, Reliability Engineering, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: rto-trace-20270515.csv], [Attachment: kv-warmstart-logs-20270515.txt], [Attachment: tabletop-invite.ics]

Team — May 28 works for us, please consider the slot confirmed. A couple of small asks before the session: 

- Please upload the CSV and TXT artifacts to the Drive link (rather than sending in-line) so our auditors can pull them after the call.
- Marcus' attestation is required before we close the SOC 2 control; can we get that by EOD Monday (May 24)?
- We'll need a simple success criteria statement added to the playbook (one paragraph) that we can include in our control testing notes — basically a 2–3 line description of what constitutes a successful warm-failover (e.g., <120s for inference-service recovery, KV cache primed within 60s, no user-impact).

If you can upload the artifacts and Marcus' signed attestation, we'll circulate the SOC 2 mapping template and add the tabletop to our control calendar. Thanks for moving quickly on this.

— Lara
